items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: And it'd take like Buddy Petit and Chris Crom, they'd be playing at them out on the lakefront

ctx.x: Somebody hire him for the job?

Yeah, it's like a city would hire him, see? And sometimes they'd have a white band up at St. Mary's Playground, up on Magazine Street and that's it, but every Sunday, and out on the lakefront they'd have them big bands like that. And it'd take like Buddy Petit and Chris Crom, they'd be playing at them out on the lakefront, West End, Spanish folk, Captain Madison, those places and like that. Well, I played several of those songs before they broke those camps down. I had a chance to play plenty of those.
I think, Harold, you mentioned once about, you mentioned once there was a bell on some of them. No, Clever, on Orleans, at the same time.
